title: 2018 AMC 12B Problem 17
statement: Let \(p\) and \(q\) be positive integers such that \[ \dfrac{5}{9}\lt\dfrac{p}{q}\lt\dfrac{4}{7} \] and \(q\) is as small as possible. What is \(q-p?\)

solutions.text:
From \(\tfrac59\lt\tfrac pq\) we get \(9p-5q\ge1,\) and from \(\tfrac pq\lt\tfrac47\) we get \(4q-7p\ge1.\) Now \[ \begin{gathered} \dfrac{1}{63}=\dfrac47-\dfrac59 \\ =\dfrac{4q-7p}{7q}+\dfrac{9p-5q}{9q} \\ \ge\dfrac{1}{7q}+\dfrac{1}{9q} \\ =\dfrac{16}{63q}. \end{gathered} \]

Hence \(q\ge16.\) With \(q=16,\) the fraction \(\tfrac{9}{16}\) lies strictly between \(\tfrac59\) and \(\tfrac47,\) so \(p=9\) and \(q-p=16-9=7.\)

Thus, the correct answer is A.
